newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Int'l Bk of Asia places HK$200 mln FRCDs.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Bk of Asia places HK$200 mln FRCDs.

text.p: International Bank of Asia has lodged HK$200 million in floating rate certificates of deposit with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority Central Moneymarkets Unit in two separate issues of HK$100 million each.
HSBC Markets was the lead manager for both issues.
The first issue of HK$100 million FRCDs will mature on February 2, 1998, while the second issue will mature on January 29, 1999. Both issues were priced at par.
The one-year certificates pay a coupon of 25 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The two-year certificates pay a coupon of 45 basis points over the three-month HIBOR.
